changes.rationale: August 10 counterparty release announces MedImmune exclusive INO-3112 rights and development collaboration, with $27.5 million upfront and milestone/royalty economics. Category is license collaboration rather than trial results.
October 14 joint release announces Priceline brands joining TripAdvisor instant booking, initially Booking.com. Integration is forthcoming; this is partnership announcement rather than earnings.

September 24 joint release announces nationwide GoBank checking-account rollout exclusively at Walmart, with nationwide availability expected by end of October. Class 10 commercialization is primary; Walmart partnership is concurrent context.

June 27 standalone release raises Q2 revenue forecast from $84–86 million to $86–88 million. It provides a forward quarterly revenue range without a routine quarterly earnings release; class 8 standalone guidance update.

November 5 release reports Q3 results. Muscle Shoals alternatives are mentioned inside the earnings report; existing earnings-led attribution retained rather than treating that context as a separately verified activist catalyst.
November 12 release reports fiscal Q2 and six-month results, including a return to profit. Product-line discussion appears within quarterly results; earnings exclusion applies.
November 20 release reports Q3 GAAP and adjusted earnings and operating performance. Existing earnings-led jump attribution retained.
May 26 release reports delayed Q4/full-year 2015 results and filed restatements. Filing catch-up and improved earnings are mixed context; no independently verified legal resolution is established.
August 13 issuer release reports Q2 financial results and provides guidance. Existing earnings-led jump attribution retained.

October 17 historical ITT Educational release reports preliminary Q2/Q3 operating results, enrollment and liquidity figures. This is retrospective period-results news, not a standalone forward guidance step-up. Preserve historical CIK 922475 identity caveat.

June 27 release previews the nearly completed quarter with revenue and EPS estimates tied to recent operating results. Treat preliminary quarterly earnings as class 1; do not promote a retrospective results preview as a standalone forward outlook step-change.

December 5 issuer release announces completion of a $100 million new-share offering and Vernon Hill appointment as chairman. Primary financing and governance event; no activist campaign or operating partnership substantiated by this release.
